    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Antigravity agent<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<p>
</p>































<p>The Antigravity agent is a general-purpose managed agent on the Gemini API. A single API call gives you an agent that reasons, executes code, manages files, and browses the web inside your own secure Linux sandbox, hosted by Google.</p>

<p>It is powered by Gemini 3.7 Flash and uses the same harness as the Antigravity IDE. You can configure the underlying Gemini model using <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent_config</code>. Available through the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/interactions-overview">Interactions API</a> and <a href="https://aistudio.google.com">Google AI Studio</a>.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">agent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"antigravity-preview-05-2026"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Read Hacker News, summarize the top 10 stories, and save the results as a PDF."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"remote"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">output_text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"@google/genai"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-ow">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({});</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">agent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"antigravity-preview-05-2026"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Read Hacker News, summarize the top 10 stories, and save the results as a PDF."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"remote"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">timeout</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-mf">300000</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">output_text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="java" data-text="Java" tabindex="-1">Java</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Java"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.AgentOption</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.CreateAgentInteraction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.Interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">com.google.genai.gaos.models.interactions.InteractionsInput</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<h2 id="capabilities" data-text="Capabilities" tabindex="-1">Capabilities</h2>

<p>Each call can provision a Linux sandbox and starts a tool-use loop. The agent plans, acts, observes results, and repeats until the task is done.</p>

<ul>
<li><strong>Code execution:</strong> Run Bash, Python, and Node.js commands. Install packages, run tests, build apps.</li>
<li><strong>File management:</strong> Read, write, edit, search, and list files in the sandbox. Files persist across interactions.</li>
<li><strong>Web access:</strong> Google Search and URL fetching for data.</li>
<li><strong>Context compaction:</strong> Automatic context compaction (triggered at ~135k tokens) to support long-running, multi-turn sessions without losing context or hitting token limits.</li>
</ul>

<p>See the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/managed-agents-quickstart">Quickstart</a> for multi-turn usage and streaming.</p>

<h2 id="supported-tools" data-text="Supported tools" tabindex="-1">Supported tools</h2>

<p>By default, the agent has access to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">code_execution</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">google_search</code>, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">url_context</code>. Filesystem tools are enabled automatically when you specify the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">environment</code> parameter. You can also define <strong>custom functions</strong> to connect the agent to your own APIs and tools. You only need to specify the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">tools</code> parameter when customizing or restricting the default set, or when adding custom functions.</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Tool</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Type value</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">Code Execution</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">code_execution</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Run shell commands (bash, Python, Node) with stdout/stderr capture.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">Google Search</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">google_search</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Search the public web.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">URL Context</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">url_context</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Fetch and read web pages.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">Filesystem</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><em>(enabled via <code translate="no" dir="ltr">environment</code>)</em></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Read, write, edit, search, and list files in the sandbox. The system enables these tools automatically when you set the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">environment</code>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">Custom Functions</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">function</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Define custom functions that the agent can request to execute. See <a href="#function-calling">Function calling</a>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">Remote MCP Server</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">mcp_server</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Register external Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers as tools. See <a href="#mcp-servers">MCP servers</a>.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>You can intercept and validate <code translate="no" dir="ltr">code_execution</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">filesystem</code> tool execution right inside the remote sandbox using synchronous <a href="/gemini-api/docs/agent-hooks">Hooks</a>.</p>

<p>To limit the agent to specific tools, pass only the ones you need:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_1" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">agent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"antigravity-preview-05-2026"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Search for the latest AI research papers on reasoning and summarize them."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"remote"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"google_search"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"url_context"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">output_text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<h2 id="multimodal-input" data-text="Multimodal Input" tabindex="-1">Multimodal Input</h2>

<p>The Antigravity agent supports multimodal inputs. Currently, only <code translate="no" dir="ltr">text</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">image</code> inputs are supported. Images must be supplied as inline base64-encoded strings (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">data</code>).</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_2" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">base64</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<h2 id="function-calling" data-text="Function calling" tabindex="-1">Function calling</h2>

<p>Function calling allows you to connect the Antigravity agent to external APIs and databases by defining custom tools the agent can invoke. For general concepts, see <a href="/gemini-api/docs/interactions/function-calling">Function calling with the Gemini API</a>.</p>

<p>The following example demonstrates a 2-turn interaction. The agent first requests a custom <code translate="no" dir="ltr">get_weather</code> function call, and the client executes it and returns the result in the second turn.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_3" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 1. Define the custom function</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">get_weather_tool</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"function"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"name"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"get_weather"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"description"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Gets the current weather for a given location."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"parameters"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"object"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"properties"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"location"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
                <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"string"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
                <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"description"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"The city and country, e.g. San Francisco, USA"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"required"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"location"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 2. Call the agent with the custom tool (Turn 1)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">agent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"antigravity-preview-05-2026"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"What is the weather in Tokyo?"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"remote"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">tools</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"code_execution"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>  <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Enable default code execution</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">get_weather_tool</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>            <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Add custom function</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Check if the agent requested a function call</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">status</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"requires_action"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Find function calls that do not have a matching function result.</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Filesystem tools (like write_file) are also represented as function calls</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># but are executed automatically by the environment.</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">executed_calls</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">step</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">call_id</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">step</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">in</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">steps</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">step</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">type</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"function_result"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<section><h3 id="javascript_3" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"@google/genai"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">location</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">required</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"location"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>

<section><h3 id="rest_3" data-text="REST" tabindex="-1">REST</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 1. Turn 1: Request function call</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">RESPONSE</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-s<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-X<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>POST<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"x-goog-api-key: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$GEMINI_API_KEY</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-d<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "agent": "antigravity-preview-05-2026",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "input": "What is the weather in Tokyo?",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "environment": "remote",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "tools": [</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">          {"type": "code_execution"},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">          {</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">              "type": "function",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">              "name": "get_weather",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">              "description": "Gets the current weather for a given location.",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">              "parameters": {</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">                  "type": "object",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">                  "properties": {</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">                      "location": {"type": "string"}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">                  },</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">                  "required": ["location"]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">              }</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">          }</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      ]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">  }'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Extract interaction ID, environment ID, and call ID (requires jq)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">INTERACTION_ID</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$RESPONSE</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'.id'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">ENVIRONMENT_ID</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$RESPONSE</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'.environment_id'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">CALL_ID</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$RESPONSE</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'.steps[] | select(.type=="function_call") | .id'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 2. Turn 2: Send function result back using variables</span>
curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-X<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>POST<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"x-goog-api-key: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$GEMINI_API_KEY</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-d<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">      \"agent\": \"antigravity-preview-05-2026\",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">      \"previous_interaction_id\": \"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$INTERACTION_ID</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">\",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">      \"environment\": \"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$ENVIRONMENT_ID</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">\",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">      \"input\": [</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">          {</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">              \"type\": \"function_result\",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">              \"name\": \"get_weather\",</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">                  \"temperature\": 23,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">                  \"unit\": \"celsius\"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">              }</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">          }</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">      ]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">  }"</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<h2 id="mcp-servers" data-text="MCP servers" tabindex="-1">MCP servers</h2>

<p>You can connect the Antigravity agent to external tools by registering remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. The agent supports remote MCP servers over streamable HTTP.</p>

<p>When registering an MCP server, you must specify the following fields in the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">tools</code> array:</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Field</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Type</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Required</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">type</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">string</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Yes</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Must be <code translate="no" dir="ltr">&quot;mcp_server&quot;</code>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">name</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">string</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Yes</td>
<td style="text-align: left">A unique identifier for the server. Must be strictly lowercase and alphanumeric (matching <code translate="no" dir="ltr">^[a-z0-9_-]+$</code>).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">url</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">string</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Yes</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The endpoint URL of the remote MCP server.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">headers</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">object</td>
<td style="text-align: left">No</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Custom headers (e.g., authentication) sent with requests.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">allowed_tools</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">array</td>
<td style="text-align: left">No</td>
<td style="text-align: left">List of tool names allowed to be executed. If omitted, all tools are allowed.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="model-selection" data-text="Model selection" tabindex="-1">Model selection</h2>

If you omit <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent_config</code>, the agent defaults to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-3.7-flash</code>.</p>

</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p>The supported values for <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent_config.model</code> are:</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Model</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Value in <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent_config.model</code></th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Gemini 3.7 Flash</strong> (default)</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-3.7-flash</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Default balanced model for reasoning, coding, and tool use.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Gemini 3.6 Flash</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-3.6-flash</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Previous generation Flash model for general agentic workflows.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Gemini 3.5 Flash</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-3.5-flash</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Lightweight model for general workflows.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-3.5-flash-lite</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Lightweight model optimized for low latency and cost-sensitive tasks.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>When creating a managed agent with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agents.create</code>, you configure the model in the exact same way by passing <code translate="no" dir="ltr">base_agent</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent_config</code>. Notice that you cannot override the model at interaction time for a managed agent created with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agents.create</code>. The model is locked to what was set when the agent was created. This ensures predictable tool calling behavior, consistent debugging, and adherence to security boundaries.</p>

<h2 id="customizing-the-agent" data-text="Customizing the agent" tabindex="-1">Customizing the agent</h2>

<p>You can extend the Antigravity agent by customizing its instructions, tools, and environment. The agent supports a filesystem-native approach to customization: you can mount files like <code translate="no" dir="ltr">AGENTS.md</code> for instructions and skills under <code translate="no" dir="ltr">.agents/skills/</code> directly into the sandbox, or pass configuration inline at interaction time. You can iterate on your configuration inline and then save it as a managed agent when you are ready.</p>

<p>For full details on how to build custom agents, see <a href="/gemini-api/docs/custom-agents">Building Managed Agents</a>.</p>

<h2 id="background-execution" data-text="Background execution" tabindex="-1">Background execution</h2>

<p>Agent tasks that involve multi-step reasoning, code execution, or file operations can take minutes to complete. Use <code translate="no" dir="ltr">background=True</code> to run the interaction asynchronously. The API returns immediately with an interaction ID that you poll until the status is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">completed</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">failed</code>.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_6" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">time</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 1. Start the interaction in the background</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">agent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"antigravity-preview-05-2026"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Run a complex analysis on the repository."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"remote"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">background</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Interaction started in background: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 2. Poll for completion</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">status</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"in_progress"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">time</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">sleep</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">5</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">status</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"completed"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">output_text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<p><a id="multi-turn-background"></a><strong>Multi-turn with background execution</strong></p>

<section><h3 id="rest_8" data-text="REST" tabindex="-1">REST</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># 1. Start first interaction in the background</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">RESPONSE</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-s<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-X<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>POST<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Api-Revision: 2026-05-20"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "environment": "remote",</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">  }'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">INTERACTION_ID</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$RESPONSE</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'.id'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">ENVIRONMENT_ID</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$RESULT</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'.environment_id'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>

<h2 id="environments" data-text="Environments" tabindex="-1">Environments</h2>

<p>Each call creates or reuses a Linux sandbox. The <code translate="no" dir="ltr">environment</code> parameter takes three forms:</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Form</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">&quot;remote&quot;</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Provision a fresh sandbox with default settings.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">&quot;env_abc123&quot;</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Reuse an existing environment by ID, preserving all files and state.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">{...}</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Full <code translate="no" dir="ltr">EnvironmentConfig</code> with custom sources and network rules.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>See <a href="/gemini-api/docs/agent-environment">Environments</a> for details on sources (Git, GCS, inline), networking, lifecycle, and resource limits.</p>

<h2 id="triggers" data-text="Triggers" tabindex="-1">Triggers</h2>

<p>Triggers let you schedule an agent to run automatically on a cron schedule. A trigger binds an agent, environment, prompt, and schedule into a persistent resource that fires without manual intervention. Each execution reuses the same environment, so files created in one run persist and are visible to the next.</p>

<h3 id="create_a_trigger" data-text="Create a trigger" tabindex="-1">Create a trigger</h3>

<p>Create a trigger by specifying a cron schedule, time zone, and the interaction configuration. The trigger starts in <code translate="no" dir="ltr">active</code> status and will fire on the next matching cron time. Save the returned <code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code> to manage the trigger in subsequent calls.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">time_zone</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>

                    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"domain"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"github.com"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>

<h3 id="pause_and_resume" data-text="Pause and resume" tabindex="-1">Pause and resume</h3>

<h2 id="availability-and-pricing" data-text="Availability and pricing" tabindex="-1">Availability and pricing</h2>

<p>Antigravity agent is available in preview through the
<a href="/gemini-api/docs/interactions-overview">Interactions API</a> in Google AI Studio
and the Gemini API for both free tier and paid tier projects.</p>

<p>Pricing follows a <a href="/gemini-api/docs/pricing#pricing-for-agents">pay-as-you-go model</a>
based on the underlying Gemini model tokens and the tools the agent uses. Unlike a
standard chat request that produces a single output, an Antigravity interaction is an
agentic workflow. A single request triggers an autonomous loop of reasoning, tool
execution, code running, and file management. Free tier projects include a free rate limit
and usage quota.</p>

<p>Antigravity interactions run multi-turn autonomous loops and can consume
significant tokens. Set <a href="#budget-controls">budget controls</a> on your request to
limit token usage. You can also monitor progress in real time with
<a href="/gemini-api/docs/streaming">SSE streaming</a>, or cancel running requests.</p>

<h3 id="budget-controls" data-text="Budget controls" tabindex="-1">Budget controls</h3>

<p>In addition to <a href="#model-selection">model selection</a>, set <code translate="no" dir="ltr">max_total_tokens</code> inside <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent_config</code> (with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">&quot;type&quot;: &quot;antigravity&quot;</code>) to limit
the total number of tokens (input + output + thinking) an interaction can consume.
Cached tokens do not count toward this limit. When the agent reaches the limit, the
interaction stops and returns with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">status: &quot;incomplete&quot;</code>. The limit is best-effort:
actual usage may slightly exceed it depending on when the agent checks the budget
between steps.</p>

<p>Set the budget on the interaction request in <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent_config</code> alongside <code translate="no" dir="ltr">agent</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">input</code>.</p>

<h4 id="continuing-incomplete-interaction" data-text="Continuing an incomplete interaction" tabindex="-1">Continuing an incomplete interaction</h4>

<p>When an interaction returns <code translate="no" dir="ltr">status: &quot;incomplete&quot;</code>, the agent&#39;s work and context
are preserved. Send a new interaction referencing the original interaction <code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code> and
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">environment_id</code> to pick up where it left off. The new interaction gets its own
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">max_total_tokens</code> budget.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_17" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Continue from where the agent stopped</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">continuation</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interactions</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">agent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"antigravity-preview-05-2026"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"continue"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">previous_interaction_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">environment</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interaction</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">environment_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">agent_config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"antigravity"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"max_total_tokens"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-mi">50000</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Status: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">continuation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">status</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<h3 id="estimated_costs" data-text="Estimated costs" tabindex="-1">Estimated costs</h3>

<p>Costs vary based on task complexity. The agent autonomously determines how many tool calls, code executions, and file operations are needed. The following estimates are based on runs.</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Task category</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Input tokens</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Output tokens</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Typical cost</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Research &amp; information synthesis</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">100k–500k</td>
<td style="text-align: left">10k–40k</td>
<td style="text-align: left">$0.30–$1.00</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Document &amp; content generation</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">100k–500k</td>
<td style="text-align: left">15k–50k</td>
<td style="text-align: left">$0.30–$1.30</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Process &amp; system design</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">100k–400k</td>
<td style="text-align: left">10k–30k</td>
<td style="text-align: left">$0.25–$0.80</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>Data processing &amp; analysis</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">300k–3M</td>
<td style="text-align: left">30k–150k</td>
<td style="text-align: left">$0.70–$3.25</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>50–70% of input tokens are typically cached. Complex agentic workflows with many tool calls can accumulate 3–5 million tokens in a single interaction, with costs up to ~$5.</p>

<p><strong>Environment compute</strong> (CPU, memory, sandbox execution) is <strong>not billed</strong> during the preview period.</p>

<h2 id="limitations" data-text="Limitations" tabindex="-1">Limitations</h2>

<ul>
<li><strong>Preview status:</strong> The Antigravity agent and the Interactions API. Features and schemas may change.</li>
<li><strong>Unsupported generation config:</strong> The following parameters are not supported and return a 400 error: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">temperature</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">top_p</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">top_k</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">stop_sequences</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">max_output_tokens</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Structured output:</strong> The Antigravity agent does not support structured outputs.</li>
<li><strong>Unavailable tools:</strong> <code translate="no" dir="ltr">file_search</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">computer_use</code>, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">google_maps</code> are not yet supported.</li>
<li><strong>Remote MCP limitations:</strong> Server-Sent Events (SSE) transport is not supported (use Streamable HTTP). Additionally, the server <code translate="no" dir="ltr">name</code> must be strictly lowercase and alphanumeric (using uppercase letters triggers a generic <code translate="no" dir="ltr">400 Bad Request</code> error).</li>
<li><strong>Filesystem tool:</strong> There is no filesystem tool at the moment. It is part of the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">environment</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Store requirement:</strong> Agent execution using <code translate="no" dir="ltr">background=True</code> requires <code translate="no" dir="ltr">store=True</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Stateful only function calling:</strong> Function calling is only supported in stateful mode. You must use <code translate="no" dir="ltr">previous_interaction_id</code> to continue the turn; reconstructing history manually (stateless mode) is not supported.</li>
<li><strong>Unsupported multimodal types.</strong> Audio, video, and document inputs are not supported at the moment. Only text and image are allowed.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="whats-next" data-text="What's next" tabindex="-1">What's next</h2>

<ul>
<li><a href="/gemini-api/docs/managed-agents-quickstart">Quickstart</a>: multi-turn conversations and streaming.</li>
<li><a href="/gemini-api/docs/custom-agents">Building Custom Agents</a>: custom instructions, skills, and saving agents.</li>
<li><a href="/gemini-api/docs/agent-environment">Environments</a>: sandbox configuration, sources, networking.</li>
<li><a href="/gemini-api/docs/agent-hooks">Hooks</a>: enforce security gates and side-effect validation inside the sandbox.</li>
<li><a href="/gemini-api/docs/deep-research">Deep Research agent</a>: long-form research tasks.</li>
<li><a href="/gemini-api/docs/interactions-overview">Interactions API</a>: the underlying API.</li>
</ul>
